item.title: Notice to Creditors and Claimants: Estate of Lorraine Alice Hanson
Life in Retirement: The case of the missing shoes
item.description: I was perplexed recently. Well, likely more than once, but this particular time was the result of finding my shoes missing when I went to leave my yoga class. My fellow yogis and I retraced my steps – had I worn a different pair than I thought I had? Did I really place them on the little shoe rack or had I stashed them somewhere odd. Was I, perhaps, already wearing them and forgot that I had put them on?
